blocks.text: 像 ARTEX 这样的智能体化攻击框架正推动云入侵事件激增。Wiz Research 分享了来自真实环境的案例，其中包括借助攻击者泄露的日志还原出一次攻击的攻防双方视角，还有“黑色十月”的最新进展，以及能够捕捉这类高频、机器速度攻击的检测规则。

blocks.text: Agentic offensive frameworks like ARTEX are driving a surge in cloud intrusions. Wiz Research shares cases from the wild, including both sides of one attack via the operator's leaked logs, an update on Black October, and the detections that catch these noisy, machine-speed attacks.
